mapper.select: SELECT av.ID, av.ARTICLE_ID, av.VERSION, av.TITLE, av.SLUG, av.SUMMARY, av.CATEGORY_ID, c.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, av.ARTICLE_TYPE, av.ARTICLE_PERM, av.COMMENT_FLAG, av.COVER_IMAGE_TYPE, av.WORDS_COUNT, av.PUBLISH_TIME FROM article_version av LEFT JOIN category c ON c.ID = av.CATEGORY_ID WHERE av.ARTICLE_ID = #{query.articleId} ORDER BY PUBLISH_TIME DESC
